data.name: Biodiversal
data.description: Biodiversal is a Colombian regenerative agriculture company founded in 2018 that sells biostimulants and plant-nutrition products and provides technical assistance to smallholder coffee farmers. Since 2024 it has co-coordinated the Coffee Biochar Project with Planboo and Circular Agro, training farmers to pyrolyze coffee pruning residues into biochar and generating durable carbon removal credits endorsed by Carbon Standards International.
